Crafting and recipes

There is no workbench: every recipe is crafted from the pack. This guide explains the panel and lists every recipe with its exact amounts.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 5 min, then look things up · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides

How the Craft tab works

Open the inventory with E and choose Craft. Recipes are grouped into four sections: Timber, Fire & food, Materials and Tools & arms. Each ingredient shows as carried / required. Everything is crafted anywhere, with no workbench, fire or furnace. Craft tab (crafting panel)

Key or actionWhat it does
Up / Down arrows, mouse wheelSelect a recipe.
Left / Right arrows, or click a sectionChange section.
Enter or C, or click CraftCraft once.
Shift + Enter, Shift + C or Shift + clickCraft repeatedly until materials or space run out (at most 256 batches).
  • In survival the ingredients are spent and the result needs room in the pack. Failures read 'Missing materials for …' or 'Not enough free carry capacity'.
  • In creative the ingredients are free ('Creative: ingredients are free').
  • A crafted tool is equipped at once and a crafted boat is selected.
  • You cannot open the inventory while inside a vehicle.
Good to know. Counts are half-metre pieces. One full one-metre block is 8 pieces, so a recipe that needs 8 of a material needs one block of it.

Which ingredients can be mixed

A few ingredients accept a whole group of materials, and you can mix the members freely. Interchangeable ingredients

  • Boards: any species (Alder, Birch or Pine).
  • Natural stone: any of 26 natural stones.
  • Hardwood or deadwood: any hardwood log or deadwood.
  • Plant fiber or Wool.

If a recipe asks for one exact species and also for any board, the exact species is filled first. The recipe then needs a second board of another species, so carry one Birch board and one Pine board to craft it. One Birch board alone is not enough.

Every other ingredient must be that exact material: Sand (not other sands), Clay (not ochre, umber, sienna, cracked or banded clay), Reeds (not Tall reeds), Limestone, Granite, Cobblestone, Moss, Chalk, Basalt, Red rock, Glass, Feather, Raw meat, Venison and Glow crystal.

Good to know. Not usable as natural stone: Magma stone, Iron ore, Bog iron, Amethyst, Salt, Sulfur crust, Mineral crust, Geyser stone and any crafted masonry. Sandstone is the exception: it counts as natural stone, although you can also craft it from sand.

Quick craft with X

With the inventory closed, X crafts the first recipe you can currently afford, in list order, not the recipe you last selected. In creative it only shows a message. Quick craft (X)

Careful. The list starts with the four log-splitting recipes and then 'Burn a charcoal pile'. With boards but no logs, X turns four boards into two Charcoal.

Fire, glass and cooking

Fire work is crafting, not a placed furnace: burn 4 boards into 2 Charcoal, then spend Charcoal to cook meat, fire Sand into Glass, blow Glass into flasks, and fire clay, limestone and lacquer. Fill flasks by pressing T at water. Charcoal, cooking and glass (no furnace)

Tip. Besides the 'Fire glass' recipe, the Survey workshop landmark's one-time find gives 8 Glass.

Gathering and reading the pack

Cutting a log on a natural tree, or a cactus stem, brings down that piece and everything growing from it. Cut the bottom log to take the whole tree. Cut a branch and the trunk below it stays standing. Felling trees

  • In survival the chop takes as long as all the wood and leaves it removes together. All of it goes into your pack.
  • If the whole harvest does not fit, the status line says 'Need X capacity free to collect this connected tree' and nothing is cut.
  • A log you placed yourself breaks like any other block, one piece at a time.
  • A finished tree reports 'Felled a tree' with the number of logs and leaves.

Shores mix Clay (below sea level), Gravel and Sand. Desert ground is Sand. Reeds grow in wetlands. Wild flax grows in some meadows of worlds made with the current generator. Feathers, wool and meat come from animals. Where crafting materials come from

Good to know. Older worlds have no Wild flax, so use Wool for bindings there.

The Pack tab lists everything you carry. Tools come first, then food and drink, blocks, materials and spawn eggs. Each group is sorted by name. Pack tab: Items and Character

Key or actionWhat it does
Left click an itemUse it, select it or equip it. A material with no use says it is stored as a crafting resource.
Hover an item, then press 1-9 or 0Bind it to that hotbar slot.
Drag an item onto a hotbar slotBind it to that slot while the inventory is open.
Mouse wheel, or Prev / NextPage through the items.
Click Items or CharacterSwitch between the item list and a turning character portrait.

Hover an item to see its name, quantity, category and click hints. The side panel turns the item in 3D and shows what it is for, where it comes from, which recipe uses it, and how much pack room one piece takes. Item tooltips and 3D previews

Good to know. 'USED IN' shows only the first recipe that names the exact item. Some stones count through the natural-stone group, so their panel can say 'USE: PLACE / BUILD' even when a recipe accepts them.

Block types and water kinds

The block table at Voxelgame f3143de9 has 180 block types, not counting Air. Each has its own name and colour. Recipes on this page name the blocks they use. Block types and material families

  • Six block types are water: Water, Hot spring water, Dark fjord water, Fresh water, Black water and Boiling water.
  • Iron ore and Bog iron can be mined and placed. No recipe uses them, and the game has no smelting yet.
  • Glow crystal is the gem that recipes use. It does not generate naturally; see the section on recipes survival cannot finish yet.

Recipes survival cannot finish yet

Red lantern, Alder rifle, Four rifle rounds, TNT and Two dynamite sticks each need Glow crystal, which does not generate naturally in the world, so a survival player cannot gather enough. They work in creative, or in survival with crystals carried over from creative by pressing F4. Glow-crystal recipes in survival

Planned, not in the game. A placeable furnace or campfire, smelting, metal tools and tool durability are planned and have no recipes in this version.

How this guide was checked

The recipe tables are generated from data/recipes.json, which was extracted from the game's recipe registry at Voxelgame fb873488 (the other features are still from the audited commit dd29d91); tools/validate_guides.py can recheck all 43 names, sections and amounts against a source snapshot. The X shortcut was separately checked at Voxelgame 5856103c (change a6d56495): it repeats the selected Craft-tab recipe.

Voxelgame main dd29d91, committed 10 October 2026; guide written 12 October 2026. Source-checked, not play-tested. Amounts are carried pieces: 8 pieces make one full one-metre block. Recipes for furnaces, smelting and metal tools do not exist yet.
